provenance.collision proxies: approximation - boxes fitted to each CAD collision mesh's own axis-aligned bounds, because MuJoCo replaces these non-convex meshes with bounding spheres; not CAD surfaces, and not a clearance certificate
provenance.gripper force limit 8 N reading: URDF effort field; NOT a measured fingertip grasp force
provenance.gripper kp / kv: simulation assumption - no DM4310 drive characterisation
provenance.joint damping 0.2: simulation assumption - NOT identified on hardware
provenance.robot base height above the floor: SCENE CHOICE - ROBOT_BASE_Z_M; the prototype URDF has no platform geometry, and the real deck height is HARDWARE_UNVERIFIED
provenance.site (TCP/fingertip) offsets: derived from CAD geometry at generation time
provenance.work surface height: SCENE CHOICE - TABLE_TOP_Z_M, set by the arm's measured top-down workspace band, not by CAD
